fusions.name: Mildewed Nick
fusions.desc: A shallow cut that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spores Along the Line
fusions.desc: Sweeps the blade around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stripping 10% of their armour for 6 seconds and slowing them by 15%. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Blade Left to Seed
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to drive a blade into the ground beside you for 15 seconds. It sheds spores on enemies within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Creeping Colonies
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
